WITH upserted AS ( INSERT INTO payment_callback_inbox ( callback_no, order_no, external_trade_no, payment_provider, paid_at, paid_amount_yuan, status, idempotency_key, raw_payload_json, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{callbackNo}, #{orderNo}, #{externalTradeNo}, #{paymentProvider}, #{paidAt}, #{paidAmountYuan}, 'RECEIVED', #{idempotencyKey}, CAST(#{rawPayloadJson} AS jsonb), NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET idempotency_key = payment_callback_inbox.idempotency_key RETURNING * )
SELECT FROM upserted

WITH picked AS ( SELECT id FROM payment_callback_inbox WHERE ( status = 'RECEIVED' OR ( status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count < #{maxRetry} AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) ) ) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), updated AS ( UPDATE payment_callback_inbox c SET status = 'PROCESSING', last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = NOW(), version = c.version + 1 FROM picked WHERE c.id = picked.id RETURNING c.* )
SELECT FROM updated

WITH raw AS ( SELECT row_number() OVER () AS rn, stream_message_id, callback_no, order_no, external_trade_no, payment_provider, paid_at_epoch_ms, paid_amount_yuan, idempotency_key, raw_payload_json, received_at_epoch_ms FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{callbacksJson} AS jsonb)) AS callback( stream_message_id text, callback_no text, order_no text, external_trade_no text, payment_provider text, paid_at_epoch_ms bigint, paid_amount_yuan numeric, idempotency_key text, raw_payload_json text, received_at_epoch_ms bigint ) ), deduped AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (idempotency_key) * FROM raw WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND idempotency_key <> '' ORDER BY idempotency_key, rn ), upserted AS ( INSERT INTO payment_callback_inbox ( callback_no, order_no, external_trade_no, payment_provider, paid_at, paid_amount_yuan, status, idempotency_key, raw_payload_json, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT callback_no, order_no, NULLIF(external_trade_no, ''), payment_provider, CASE WHEN paid_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN NOW() ELSE to_timestamp(paid_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END, paid_amount_yuan, 'PROCESSING', idempotency_key, CAST(raw_payload_json AS jsonb), NOW(), NOW() FROM deduped ORDER BY rn ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET status = 'PROCESSING', last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = NOW(), version = payment_callback_inbox.version + 1 WHERE ( payment_callback_inbox.status = 'RECEIVED' OR ( payment_callback_inbox.status = 'FAILED' AND payment_callback_inbox.retry_count < #{maxRetry} AND (payment_callback_inbox.next_retry_at IS NULL OR payment_callback_inbox.next_retry_at <= NOW()) ) OR ( payment_callback_inbox.status = 'PROCESSING' AND payment_callback_inbox.updated_at <= NOW() - (#{processingTimeoutMs} * INTERVAL '1 millisecond') ) ) RETURNING * ), terminal AS ( SELECT c.* FROM payment_callback_inbox c INNER JOIN deduped d ON d.idempotency_key = c.idempotency_key WHERE c.status = 'PROCESSED' OR (c.status = 'FAILED' AND c.retry_count >= #{maxRetry}) ), stream_rows AS ( SELECT raw.stream_message_id, raw.rn, FALSE AS stream_ack_only, upserted.* FROM raw INNER JOIN upserted ON upserted.idempotency_key = raw.idempotency_key UNION ALL SELECT raw.stream_message_id, raw.rn, TRUE AS stream_ack_only, c.* FROM raw INNER JOIN terminal c ON c.idempotency_key = raw.idempotency_key )
SELECT stream_message_id AS "streamMessageId", stream_ack_only AS "streamAckOnly", (NOT stream_ack_only) AS "streamClaimed", id, callback_no AS "callbackNo", order_no AS "orderNo", external_trade_no AS "externalTradeNo", payment_provider AS "paymentProvider", paid_at AS "paidAt", paid_amount_yuan AS "paidAmountYuan", status, retry_count AS "retryCount", next_retry_at AS "nextRetryAt", result_outcome AS "resultOutcome", result_order_status AS "resultOrderStatus", refund_no AS "refundNo", last_error_code AS "lastErrorCode", last_error_message AS "lastErrorMessage", idempotency_key AS "idempotencyKey", raw_payload_json::text AS "rawPayloadJson", version, created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM stream_rows ORDER BY rn
mapper.update: WITH result_rows AS ( SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{resultsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( callback_no text, status text, result_outcome text, result_order_status text, refund_no text, last_error_code text, last_error_message text, next_retry_at_epoch_ms bigint ) ) UPDATE payment_callback_inbox c SET status = result_rows.status, result_outcome = result_rows.result_outcome, result_order_status = result_rows.result_order_status, refund_no = result_rows.refund_no, last_error_code = result_rows.last_error_code, last_error_message = result_rows.last_error_message, retry_count = CASE WHEN result_rows.status = 'FAILED' THEN c.retry_count + 1 ELSE c.retry_count END, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN result_rows.next_retry_at_epoch_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(result_rows.next_retry_at_epoch_ms / 1000.0) END, updated_at = NOW(), version = c.version + 1 FROM result_rows WHERE c.callback_no = result_rows.callback_no AND c.status = 'PROCESSING'

SELECT FROM payment_callback_inbox
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
